zustand_state_persistence.description: Zustand store does not persist state across page reloads
zustand_state_persistence.impact: Éveil frequency/memory selections reset on page reload, causing Territoire role to show default 'EXPLORATEUR' instead of derived role (e.g., 'GRIOT' for Musique)
zustand_state_persistence.workaround: Complete onboarding flow in single session without page reload
zustand_state_persistence.suggested_fix: Add zustand persist middleware to save state to localStorage
